apps.compose:
name: jellyfin
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/jellyfin:10.11.11
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: "${PUID:-1000}"
      PGID: "${PGID:-1000}"
      TZ: "${TZ:-UTC}"
    ports:
      - target: 8096
        published: "8096"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/jellyfin/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/Media
        target: /media
        read_only: true
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: PUID
          description:
            en_US: User identifier used for media files.
            es_ES: Identificador de usuario utilizado para los archivos.
        - container: PGID
          description:
            en_US: Group identifier used for media files.
            es_ES: Identificador de grupo utilizado para los archivos.
        - container: TZ
          description:
            en_US: Container timezone.
            es_ES: Zona horaria del contenedor.
      ports:
        - container: "8096"
          description:
            en_US: Jellyfin web interface.
            es_ES: Interfaz web de Jellyfin.
      volumes:
        - container: /config
          description:
            en_US: Persistent Jellyfin configuration.
            es_ES: Configuración persistente de Jellyfin.
        - container: /media
          description:
            en_US: Read-only media library.
            es_ES: Biblioteca multimedia de solo lectura.
x-casaos:
  id: com.alcoit.jellyfin
  version: "10.11.11"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: jellyfin
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Media
  description:
    en_US: Private media system.
    es_ES: Sistema privado de contenido multimedia.
  developer: Jellyfin
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Jellyfin/icon.png
  index: /
  port_map: "8096"
  scheme: http
  tagline:
    en_US: Your media, under your control.
    es_ES: Tu contenido multimedia bajo tu control.
  thumbnail: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/AlcoIT-Software/alcoit-homelab-catalog@main/Apps/Jellyfin/thumbnail.svg
  title:
    en_US: Jellyfin
    es_ES: Jellyfin
apps.name: Jellyfin

apps.compose:
name: pihole
services:
  pihole:
    image: pihole/pihole:2026.05.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - NET_ADMIN
    ports:
      - target: 53
        published: "53"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 53
        published: "53"
        protocol: udp
      - target: 80
        published: "8081"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      TZ: "${TZ:-UTC}"
      FTLCONF_webserver_api_password: casaos
      FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode: all
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/pi-hole/etc-pihole
        target: /etc/pihole
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: TZ
          description:
            en_US: Container timezone.
            es_ES: Zona horaria del contenedor.
        - container: FTLCONF_webserver_api_password
          description:
            en_US: Pi-hole administrator password. Change the initial value.
            es_ES: Contraseña de administración de Pi-hole. Cambia el valor inicial.
        - container: FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode
          description:
            en_US: Interfaces where Pi-hole accepts DNS queries.
            es_ES: Interfaces donde Pi-hole acepta consultas DNS.
      ports:
        - container: "53"
          description:
            en_US: DNS port.
            es_ES: Puerto DNS.
        - container: "53"
          protocol: udp
          description:
            en_US: DNS port.
            es_ES: Puerto DNS.
        - container: "80"
          description:
            en_US: Pi-hole web interface.
            es_ES: Interfaz web de Pi-hole.
      volumes:
        - container: /etc/pihole
          description:
            en_US: Persistent Pi-hole configuration.
            es_ES: Configuración persistente de Pi-hole.
x-casaos:
  id: com.alcoit.pihole
  version: "2026.05.0"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: pihole
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Networking
  description:
    en_US: Network-wide DNS filtering.
    es_ES: Filtrado DNS para toda la red.
  developer: Pi-hole
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Pi-hole/icon.png
  index: /admin
  port_map: "8081"
  scheme: http
  tagline:
    en_US: Network-wide ad blocking.
    es_ES: Bloqueo de publicidad para toda la red.
  thumbnail: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/AlcoIT-Software/alcoit-homelab-catalog@main/Apps/Pi-hole/thumbnail.svg
  title:
    en_US: Pi-hole
    es_ES: Pi-hole
apps.name: Pi-hole

apps.compose:
name: vaultwarden
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:1.36.0
    restart: unless-stopped
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    environment:
      SIGNUPS_ALLOWED: "${SIGNUPS_ALLOWED:-true}"
      INVITATIONS_ALLOWED: "${INVITATIONS_ALLOWED:-true}"
      SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT: "${SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT:-false}"
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "8082"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /DATA/AppData/vaultwarden
        target: /data
    x-casaos:
      envs:
        - container: SIGNUPS_ALLOWED
          description:
            en_US: Allows account creation. Turn it off after creating your first account.
            es_ES: Permite crear cuentas. Desactívalo después de crear tu primera cuenta.
        - container: INVITATIONS_ALLOWED
          description:
            en_US: Allows existing users to invite other people.
            es_ES: Permite que los usuarios existentes inviten a otras personas.
        - container: SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT
          description:
            en_US: Shows password hints in emails. Disabled for better privacy.
            es_ES: Muestra pistas de contraseña en los correos. Está desactivado para mayor privacidad.
      ports:
        - container: "80"
          description:
            en_US: Vaultwarden web interface. Configure HTTPS before storing real passwords.
            es_ES: Interfaz web de Vaultwarden. Configura HTTPS antes de guardar contraseñas reales.
      volumes:
        - container: /data
          description:
            en_US: Encrypted vault data and persistent configuration.
            es_ES: Datos de la bóveda y configuración persistente.
x-casaos:
  id: com.alcoit.vaultwarden
  version: "1.36.0"
  architectures:
    - amd64
    - arm64
  main: vaultwarden
  author: AlcoIT Software
  category: Security
  description:
    en_US: Lightweight password manager compatible with Bitwarden applications. HTTPS is required for secure use.
    es_ES: Gestor de contraseñas ligero compatible con las aplicaciones de Bitwarden. Requiere HTTPS para un uso seguro.
  developer: Vaultwarden
  icon: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/IceWhaleTech/CasaOS-AppStore@main/Apps/Vaultwarden/icon.png
  index: /
  port_map: "8082"
  scheme: http
  tagline:
    en_US: Keep your passwords on your own server.
    es_ES: Guarda tus contraseñas en tu propio servidor.
  thumbnail: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/AlcoIT-Software/alcoit-homelab-catalog@main/Apps/Vaultwarden/thumbnail.svg
  title:
    en_US: Vaultwarden
    es_ES: Vaultwarden
apps.name: Vaultwarden
